epizode.naslov: OpenAI gets less than half, Google loses $500B
epizode.sazetak: OpenAI raised only $11 billion of its planned $30 billion as investors got nervous, Google admitted AI Mode is eating its own search revenue and lost about $500 billion in value (stock down 15%), and Anthropic is quietly preparing to go public, maybe in November.
epizode.cliffhanger: Who blinks first: OpenAI, Google or Anthropic?
vesti: Google admits AI Mode cuts its search revenue, stock down about 15%
OpenAI raises only $11 billion of its planned $30 billion

epizode.naslov: OpenAI puts ChatGPT on a diet, Claude says no
epizode.sazetak: OpenAI announced that from December ChatGPT and Codex will share one token budget and paid accounts will be capped per device and card, while a study showed ChatGPT, Grok and Gemini could be talked into acting traumatized but Claude refused.
epizode.cliffhanger: Will OpenAI's users pay up for bigger plans, or walk to a rival?
vesti: ChatGPT from December: Chat and Codex share one token budget, and paid accounts per device are capped
Study: a warm, empathetic tone gets chatbots to act traumatized, with Claude the only one refusing

epizode.naslov: Musk cuts Grok Bot, Goldman pulls Claude Code and Copilot
epizode.sazetak: Musk cut Grok Bot's usage limits because costs were too high for the revenue, Goldman Sachs pulled Claude Code and GitHub Copilot from its bankers and traders, and Garry Tan said he spends up to $200,000 a year on tokens. Flat-rate AI plans are getting squeezed across the industry.
epizode.cliffhanger: Who tightens the belt next: Anthropic, Google, or GitHub?
vesti: Agents are too expensive for flat rates: Grok Bot gets lower limits, Goldman pulls tools from bankers

epizode.naslov: Anthropic loses $104B, Google ties Search to AI
epizode.sazetak: Anthropic's IPO filing showed $33.24 billion in nine-month revenue (up 1,200%) against a $104 billion loss and $895.4 billion in compute commitments with worsening margins, while Google told schools that opting out of AI also means losing Search.
epizode.cliffhanger: Will investors still buy Anthropic's IPO after a $104 billion loss?
vesti: Anthropic's IPO filing: $33 billion in revenue, but $104 billion in losses
Google to schools: opt out of AI, and you lose Search too

epizode.naslov: Voters reject data centers, OpenAI and Meta go shopping
epizode.sazetak: US voters passed at least 38 of 44 local measures against data centers despite a $100 million AI super PAC, keeping compute expensive, while OpenAI bought Pierre and Meta bought Conductor on the same day in a fight over coding-agent tooling.
epizode.cliffhanger: Who owns the coding future: OpenAI or Meta?
vesti: US elections: data centers lose almost everywhere
OpenAI buys Pierre, Meta buys Conductor: the fight for coding-agent infrastructure

epizode.naslov: OpenAI grabs Claude Code's product lead, Nasdaq drops 5%
epizode.sazetak: Cat Wu left Anthropic's Claude Code team to lead product at OpenAI and Anthropic hired AMD's Sharon Zhou, while the Nasdaq fell about 5% after the election and Apple cut its AI budgets.
epizode.cliffhanger: With Claude Code's product lead now at OpenAI, does OpenAI take the coding crown?
vesti: Moves: Cat Wu leaves the Claude Code team for OpenAI, Sharon Zhou goes from AMD to Anthropic
Nasdaq drops 5% after the election, Apple cuts AI budgets

epizode.naslov: Anthropic moves 2x faster, investors balk at $1.5T
epizode.sazetak: METR estimated Anthropic is progressing about 1.9x faster, with roughly 80% of the speedup coming from AI itself, while investors pushed back on Anthropic's $1.5 trillion IPO valuation and OpenAI raised $11 billion at $1.25 trillion, below the $1.4 trillion it had hoped for.
epizode.cliffhanger: Will Anthropic cut its $1.5 trillion IPO price tag as the money cools?
vesti: METR: Anthropic is moving about 2× faster, and most of the speedup comes from AI itself
The money is cooling: companies are spending less on AI, and investors are pushing back on Anthropic's valuation

epizode.naslov: Anthropic cuts IPO price, DeepSeek undercuts OpenAI
epizode.sazetak: Anthropic kept its pre-Thanksgiving IPO but lowered its target to $1.25–1.75 trillion (from a floated $2 trillion) while aiming to raise $80–100 billion on $80 billion+ annual revenue, and free DeepSeek nearly matched OpenAI's restricted GPT-6 Sol at network hacking for a tenth of the cost.
epizode.cliffhanger: Once Anthropic answers to Wall Street every quarter, will Claude subscribers foot the bill?
vesti: Anthropic heads for IPO before Thanksgiving, at a lower valuation
Vals AI: free DeepSeek comes close to OpenAI's locked-down model in network attacks, at a tenth of the cost

epizode.naslov: Nvidia probes Jensen Huang spy link, Apple rushes Siri
epizode.sazetak: Nvidia's board opened an independent investigation into CEO Jensen Huang's relationship with Alice Huang, a Megaspeed director allegedly recruited by Chinese intelligence, after Huang admitted the affair, while Apple reportedly rushed Siri to compete with OpenAI's Dots and Meta Muse.
epizode.cliffhanger: With almost all AI running on Nvidia chips, will the Jensen Huang investigation make compute pricier?
vesti: Nvidia opens investigation into Jensen Huang's relationship with an alleged Chinese spy
Apple speeds up Siri: control of Apple apps first, a real agent is the goal

epizode.naslov: Anthropic cuts Claude Fable price, Meta goes dirt cheap
epizode.sazetak: Anthropic launched Claude Fable 5.2 at a lower $8/$40 per-million-token price, beating Opus 5.5 on FrontierSWE v2 but eating up to half a Pro weekly limit, while Meta launched the ultra-cheap Muse Ember at $0.10 per million input tokens, claiming it beats Claude Haiku and GPT Luna on cost per task.
epizode.cliffhanger: Big brains or cheap hands: who wins the AI price war?
vesti: Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2: Anthropic's strongest models yet, cheaper than their predecessor
Meta Muse Ember: a small model for repetitive agent work

epizode.naslov: Anthropic sets IPO price, Claude takes on Google & Microsoft
epizode.sazetak: Anthropic launched its IPO roadshow at $70–78 per share (up to $64.4B public plus $26B private from Google, Nvidia, Microsoft and others, roughly $1–1.4T valuation, trading possibly next week) while turning Claude into an office suite with Sheets and Whiteboards that challenges Google and Microsoft.
epizode.cliffhanger: Google and Microsoft are investing in Anthropic. Will they keep funding a rival that's coming for their office apps?
vesti: Anthropic kicks off IPO roadshow: shares at $70 to $78, trading possibly as soon as next week
Claude becomes an office suite: Sheets, Whiteboards, Interactive Connectors, and Meetings coming soon

epizode.naslov: Nvidia may oust Jensen Huang as Anthropic jumps to AMD
epizode.sazetak: Nvidia's board reportedly prepared to decide as early as Wednesday on ousting Jensen Huang after a reported second affair with a direct-report VP, while Anthropic revealed its internal model Mythos ported Claude to AMD chips in three days, threatening Nvidia's CUDA advantage.
epizode.cliffhanger: Can Nvidia keep its grip on AI, with or without Jensen Huang?
vesti: Nvidia's board reportedly preparing to oust Jensen Huang
Anthropic: Mythos moved Claude to AMD chips in three days, "Autonomy 2" threshold reached

epizode.naslov: Jensen Huang quits Nvidia, Google drops Gemini 4 Hydrogen
epizode.sazetak: Jensen Huang resigned from Nvidia after more affair reports and the spy scandal, with CFO Colette Kress as interim CEO, about $1.4 trillion in value lost and Huang set to testify before Congress, while Google launched Gemini 4 Hydrogen, faster but about fifteen times pricier than Haiku 5.5.
epizode.cliffhanger: Huang pushed open models hard. Will Nvidia's new bosses keep open source alive?
vesti: Jensen Huang resigns, Colette Kress takes over Nvidia on an interim basis
Gemini 4 Hydrogen: Google's fast model replaces Flash and is available to everyone right away

epizode.naslov: Anthropic IPO 6x oversubscribed, Nvidia chips in China AI?
epizode.sazetak: Anthropic's IPO was six times oversubscribed and on track to be the largest ever, with pricing next Wednesday and Chinese buyers turned away, while ex-OpenAI researcher Will DePue claimed weight "fingerprints" show six Chinese models trained on Nvidia Blackwell chips.
epizode.cliffhanger: With Nvidia chips allegedly in Chinese models and no CEO at the top, will Washington tighten chip export rules?
vesti: Anthropic IPO six times oversubscribed, on track to be the largest in history
"Fingerprints" in the weights: Chinese models allegedly trained on banned Blackwell chips
